Currency Act
(CHAPTER 69)
Currency
(Denominations and Characteristics of Coins)
Notification 2015
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 28 May 2015 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

In the centre is the Singapore Arms with the year-date “2015” below it, and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coins. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the $50 and $5 coins.
$50 Gold Proof Coin
The design features our educators. The foreground depicts educators in a range of teaching activities. The background features a classroom scene in a primary school.
$5 Silver Proof Coin
The design features higher education. The foreground depicts students, in colour, engaged in various fields of study — culinary arts at the Institute of Technical Education (ITE), engineering at a polytechnic, and medicine at a university. The background features the ITE Headquarters and ITE College Central, and National University of Singapore Bukit Timah campus.
$2 Cupro-Nickel Proof-like Coin
The design features primary and secondary education. The foreground depicts students, in colour, engaged in diverse learning activities, in both academic and non-academic domains. The background features the Bukit Panjang Government High School.
In each design, the tagline ‘Education, Building Our Nation Together’ and the official SG50 logo (in colour only for the $5 silver proof coin and $2 cupro-nickel proof-like coin) are featured within a ribbon across the coin. The denomination of the coin in figures is below the SG50 logo at the right of the coin.
